Hello Liam,
You are in "Client sync: Mobile Wallet" on 2026-10-21 at 11:00. Here is what to settle with the client so the requirements are fixed before the work moves on.

Questions to settle:
1. When should we freeze releases for the festive season? Ask the client for exact dates and agree them in the meeting. (memory item I0394)
2. How will the client's staff be trained before go-live? Agree who trains, when, and in what format. (memory item I0506)
3. Has the client sent the old data export? DevX needs it in the shared folder to run the migration. Agree a firm date. (memory item I0504)
4. Will the client share the payment gateway sandbox keys? This task has been open since 22 June. Agree a date. (memory item I0218)
5. Will the client send the brand guide and logo files? This task has been open since 9 June. Agree a date. (memory item I0169)
6. What new dates go into the shared plan now that offline mode is cut? The plan update has been open since May and July. Agree the dates and who updates the plan. (memory item I0092, I0263)
7. Which build will DevX show at the next review, and when is it? Agree the date and what the demo covers. (memory item I0126)
8. Does the client's testing feedback count as complete? The client sent comments on the staging build in Slack (labels too small on biometric login and peer transfer). Confirm if more comments are due, and agree a cut-off date. (memory item I0128, I0170)

Decisions that changed since last time:
- Offline mode is cut from phase one to save eight weeks. Confirm the client agrees, and record it as frozen.
- The client team will clean the old records and DevX will run the migration. This answers the earlier migration question. Confirm both sides accept their part.

Watch out for:
- The offline mode cut has no linked question, so it may not have been agreed in writing with the client. Get a clear yes in the meeting. Unverified: whether the client has already accepted it.
- The offline mode cut saves eight weeks, so the shared plan dates must change. Do not close the meeting without new dates.
- The data migration depends on the client sending the old data export and cleaning the records. Ask for dates for both. Without them, the migration date is a guess.
- On 19 October the client (Naveen Prasad) asked who to contact about the wallet onboarding rollout. On 7 October the client (Alisha Dsouza) asked who to contact about the merchant QR rollout. Unverified: whether anyone answered either one. Name an owner for each rollout in the meeting.
- The client sent label-size comments on biometric login (9 October) and peer transfer (12 October). They said the transaction history screen looks good (8 October). Confirm what DevX will change and which screens are approved.
- Some tasks appear twice in the open list: sending meeting notes (I0125, I0462), testing the build (I0128, I0170) and the shared plan update (I0092, I0263). Some of these may be stale. Check them and close the old ones.

Eight points need a decision in the Mobile Wallet client sync on 21 October 2026 at 11:00 AM IST. Two are real open questions: the festive release freeze dates (I0394) and the staff training plan (I0506). Six are overdue client or DevX tasks that block the plan: data export, sandbox keys, brand files, shared plan dates, demo build and test feedback. Two recent decisions must be confirmed with the client and frozen: cutting offline mode from phase one (I0505) and the data migration split (I0502). Ask for the owner of the onboarding and merchant QR rollouts, because the client asked twice and the record shows no answer.
